pricingEvidence.evidence: Web search summary: "Enhance Speech is completely free with no Adobe subscription required… The Premium plan costs $9.99/month (also available at $99.99/year)… The free tier includes Enhance Speech processing for 1 hour daily"

plans.name: Free
plans.quota: Enhance Speech 1 hour per day, files up to 30 minutes

plans.name: Premium
plans.quota: Enhance Speech 4 hours per day, files up to 2 hours, batch and video

nl.tagline: Maakt spraakopnames met één klik als uit een studio
nl.description: Adobe Podcast (met Enhance Speech) haalt ruis en galm uit spraakopnames en laat ze klinken alsof ze in een studio zijn opgenomen. De basis is gratis te gebruiken in de browser; Premium verhoogt de limieten en voegt video en batch-verwerking toe.
limitations: Gratis: 1 uur verwerking per dag, bestanden tot 30 minuten

en.tagline: One-click studio-quality speech from any recording
en.description: Adobe Podcast (with Enhance Speech) removes noise and echo from speech recordings so they sound studio-recorded. The basics are free in the browser; Premium raises limits and adds video and batch processing.
bestFor: Podcasters and teachers without a studio
limitations: Free: 1 hour of processing per day, files up to 30 minutes
